faces.name: Trove Mage
faces.oracleText: When Trove Mage enters, seek an artifact card from among the top ten cards of your library, then shuffle.

faces.name: Trove Tracker
faces.oracleText:
When this creature dies, draw a card.
Encore {5}{U}{U} ({5}{U}{U}, Exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. They gain haste. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Activate only as a sorcery.)

faces.name: Trove Warden
faces.oracleText:
Vigilance
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, exile target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard.
When this creature dies, put each permanent card exiled with it onto the battlefield under the control of that card's owner.

faces.name: Trove of Temptation
faces.oracleText:
Each opponent must attack you or a planeswalker you control with at least one creature each combat if able.
At the beginning of your end step, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
